description:
Taeha, who works as a cook at a restaurant, always lives alone without anyone approaching him due to his bully-like impression. Then one day, he meets Joowon, a part-time worker, at a cafe he went to on a coffee errand, and unlike himself, there are many people around him and he feels a feeling of admiration for him for being kind. In the end, he secretly takes pictures or spies on social media, and he becomes more and more of a stalker and soon gets caught by Joo Won... Taeha, who works as a cook at a restaurant, has the impression of a gangster.

**Original Webtoon:**
